records.summary: Ana Lucía did her citizenship process at the Jerusalem branch; they asked for the originals of the opening documents, saw and copied them, and required the personal letter to be in Hebrew.
practices: Asks citizenship applicants to bring the originals of the documents presented when opening the case, then copies them and sends them home
Requires the personal letter for the citizenship application to be written in Hebrew

records.summary: Alix Pahaut (not married, after permanent residency) was told at the Afula general counter to write a personal letter for the citizenship application, and days later was emailed a list of centre-of-life documents.
practices: Tells citizenship applicants to write a personal letter at the general counter, which they can write on the spot
Emails the list of documents to bring to the appointment a few days after the citizenship application is submitted
Asks for centre-of-life documents for the past 3 years, nothing from the home country
